t: The $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ will place blocks from its inventory in the world. It will place blocks in the $(l:programming/area)area/$ specified, starting with locations that are closest to it.$(p)You can control the order in which blocks are placed: $(thing)Right-click/$ the widget to specify if the $(item)Drone/$ should place blocks layer by layer, and if so from top to bottom or vice versa.
$(l:tools/drone)雄蜂/$会将其容器中的方块放置到世界中。它会在指定的$(l:programming/area)区域/$内放置方块，并从离它最近的位置开始。$(p)你可以控制方块的放置顺序：$(thing)右击/$该组件，以指定$(item)雄蜂/$是否应按层放置方块，以及若按层放置时是从上到下还是反过来。

Normally, the $(item)Drone/$ will place blocks from its inventory in order, starting from the first slot (bear in mind that drone inventories only have a single slot by default, but $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#inventory)Inventory Upgrades/$ can be used to increase that).$(p)By checking the $(thing)Place Random Blocks/$ option, the $(item)Drone/$ will select blocks at random from its inventory to place.
通常情况下，$(item)无人机/$会按顺序放置其物品栏中的方块，从第一个槽位开始（请记住，无人机默认只有一个槽位，但可以使用$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#inventory)物品栏升级/$来增加槽位）。$(p)勾选$(thing)放置随机方块/$选项后，$(item)无人机/$就会从物品栏中随机选择方块来放置。

The number of place actions can be limited to a specified amount by $(thing)right-clicking/$ the widget. If set to 1 for example, the $(item)Drone/$ will only place one block, and the widget is considered done after placing that one block.$(p)If no limit is set, the widget is only considered done when unable to place any more blocks.
可通过$(thing)右击/$该组件，将放置操作的次数限制为指定数量。比如设为 1 时，$(item)雄蜂/$只会放置一个方块，并且在放下这一个方块后，该组件就会被视为已完成。$(p)如果未设置限制，则只有在无法继续放置更多方块时，该组件才会被视为已完成。

Finally, you can specify which blocks from the $(item)Drone's/$ inventory may be placed by connecting an $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filter/$ widget. Connect on the $(italic)right/$ to whitelist items, and on the $(italic)left/$ to blacklist items.
最后，你可以通过连接一个$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$组件，来指定$(item)无人机的/$容器中哪些方块可以被放置。连接在$(italic)右侧/$可将物品加入白名单，连接在$(italic)左侧/$则会将物品加入黑名单。
